answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when independent audits confirm coordinated, duplicate identities. A newcomer can still join, but creating a hundred Sybils now means locking up a hundred stakes and risking their loss; the attacker also has to keep each identity active long enough to earn a reputation. This raises the cost of flooding without pretending to prove personhood: like a jetty against a surge, it slows cheap attacks, while a pearl of genuine trust builds over a longer horizon.
